fact: On 24 March 2026 the government launched the structuring projects of the New Deal Technologique (portfolio of about 1,100 billion FCFA for 2025-2034), with a Digital Governance Committee (GouvNum), created in March 2025 under the Primature, to coordinate and prioritise projects.
title: New Deal technologique : le portail e-Sénégal désormais opérationnel
